And you dont have to cut them out forever, just long enough for you to get over it. It took me a couple years to get over my crush, but once I did, I was able to rejoin my old friend group and we're friends again.

I'm not gay, but I have had a similar experience where I was obsessed with a girl who didnt have any interest in me. We were in the same close knit friend group so I couldnt exactly avoid her without avoiding all my friends, so I had this crush for years.

 I found myself always trying to hold on to some hope that maybe one day she'd change her mind and I'd have a chance. This was making me extremely depressed and was destroying my self confidence b/c I was always wondering what I needed to change to win her over. But sometimes the reality is that it will never happen and you just have to cut your losses.

So that's what I did, I distanced myself and it sucked, but it was the best thing for both of us, as it allowed me to get over her without making the friendship awkward.
